### addAttr

Add an attribute to objects (Maya's addAttr): attributeType for a single value or, with multi, an array of them; dataType for strings and arrays (stringArray, doubleArray, Int32Array, vectorArray). attributeType='compound' groups the attributes then added with parent=; a multi compound gives each element every child, node.targets[2].weight. Compounds nest one level. Saved with the scene. Returns the new plugs.

**Objects:** objects

| `attributeType` | `at` | str |  | bool, long, float, double, double3, enum, matrix or compound (Lila's int, vec3 too). |

| `defaultValue` | `dv` | Any |  | Default value (each element's, for an array). |

| `softMinValue` | `smn` | float |  | Slider minimum. |
| `softMaxValue` | `smx` | float |  | Slider maximum. |
| `enumName` | `en` | str |  | Enum labels, 'low:medium:high'. |
| `keyable` | `k` | bool | `False` | Show it in the channel box, where it can be keyed. |

### addCorrective

Turn a sculpt of the posed mesh into a corrective morph target. The fix is taken back through the skin into rest space (pose-space inversion) so it applies before skinning and matches the sculpt at this pose, and a pose driver reading each driver joint against its rest drives the weight: 1 at this pose, 0 at rest. Several drivers multiply (a combination corrective). Give the sculpt then the base (the base can be left out for a sculpt made by sculptCorrective). Returns {target, drivers, residual}.

**Objects:** sculpt, base?

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `driver` | `d` | Any |  | Joint name or list of joints. Default: the skin's most rotated influence. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | The target's name. Default: <driver>_corrective. |
| `axis` |  | str | `'x'` | Each driver's twist axis (its bone axis). One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `radius` |  | float | `0.0` | Degrees from the pose where the weight reaches 0; 0 uses the rest-to-pose angle. |
| `twistWeight` |  | float | `0.0` | How much twist about the axis counts, 0 ignoring it. |
| `falloff` |  | str | `'smooth'` | linear \| smooth \| smoother |
| `keep` |  | bool | `False` | Keep the sculpt mesh instead of deleting it. |

### addModifier

Add a modifier to the top of a mesh's stack. params sets its parameters. Returns its name. modifierKinds(docs=True) also lists kinds extensions add later.

Kinds:
- array: Repeats the mesh in a row, around a circle or in a grid, each copy stepped from the last. Use it for railings, stairs, tiles, gear teeth and bolts round a flange. Radial with weld on turns one modelled wedge into an exact N-fold whole.
- autoBevel: Bevels the fold edges it finds live on its input by angle, side and length rules, plus edges picked by hand. Use it for game-art bevels that keep following the mesh as you edit it.
- bevel: Bevels every edge sharper than an angle so hard corners catch the light. A quick live bevel; Auto Bevel has finer edge rules and hand-picked edges.
- boolean: A boolean kept live: cuts, joins or intersects this mesh with a cutter mesh, so moving or editing the cutter updates the result. Stack one per cutter. Apply bakes it.
- curveArray: Repeats the mesh along a curve: by count or spacing, fitted to its length, optional start and end pieces, each copy placed on the curve's frame or bent along it, with random turn, scale and offset. Follows curve edits.
- curveDeform: Bends the mesh along a curve, its forward axis running along it (Curve Warp, Path Deform): offset, stretch to fit, roll, twist and scale ramps, the curve's tilt and radius. Editing or moving the curve updates it.
- decimate: Reduces the triangle count while keeping the shape, silhouette, UVs and normals. Use it for LODs or to lighten scans and sculpts.
- extrude: Extrudes faces, or grows strips off edges, kept live: the faces or edges selected when it was added follow later edits under it, and its thickness and offset stay adjustable. Without a selection it extrudes every face.
- mirror: Adds a mirrored copy across a plane through the object's origin and welds the seam. Model one half of a symmetrical object and let this build the other.
- solidify: Gives a surface thickness: an inner shell offset along the normals, joined to the outer one at open borders. Use it to turn planes and open shells into solid panels.
- splitRings: Subdivides one way, kept live: loops across the rings of the edges or faces selected when it was added, curved to the surface. Without a selection it splits the whole mesh.
- subdivision: Smooths the mesh with Catmull-Clark subdivision. Use it to turn a low-poly cage into a smooth high-poly surface.
- surfaceFlow: Flows the mesh onto a surface (FlowAlongSrf): its XZ footprint maps onto the surface's UV rectangle, or a rectangular patch of quads, and its height follows the surface normal. Editing or moving the surface updates it.
- transferAttributes: Transfer Attributes kept live: copies UVs, normals, color sets, positions or named layers from a source mesh, so editing or moving the source updates this mesh without baking. Apply bakes the result.
- triangulate: Splits every face into triangles. Use it to see, or lock in, the triangulation an engine will get.
- weightedNormals: Weights vertex normals by face area so big flat faces shade flat and the bevels take the curvature. Use it on bevelled hard-surface game meshes.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` |  | str |  | Modifier kind, such as bevel or mirror (see Kinds). |
| `params` |  | Any |  | {param: value} to set on the new modifier. |

### addMorphTarget

Add targets to a morph (or the morph on a mesh, made if missing): the first argument, then target meshes. With no target meshes it adds one empty target named by name, to sculpt with editMorphTarget. Returns the new target nodes, whose weight attrs drive the morphs.

**Objects:** morph or mesh, targets...

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `live` |  | bool | `False` | Keep the targets connected so editing them updates the morphs. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Export name for a single or empty target. Default: the target mesh's name. |

### addSpace

Give a transform or joint spaces to animate in: 'world' or other nodes (its parent is always space 0). Its space channel (keyable, in the channel box) then picks the frame translate, rotate and scale are read in, and switchSpace changes it keeping the pose. With no space flag, the last selected node gets the others as spaces. Returns the node's spaces.

**Objects:** nodes

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space` | `sp` | Any |  | 'world', a node name, or a list of them. |
| `maintainOffset` | `mo` | bool | `True` | Start each space where the parent is now, so adding and switching there change nothing; off uses the target's own frame (the origin for world). |

### addToProxySet

Make meshes pieces of a proxy set: each bound to a joint (the nearest bone by default) and moved under the set. A proxy piece is parent constrained to its joint; a true piece is skinned with the real mesh's weights.

**Objects:** set, meshes...

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `joint` | `j` | str |  | The joint the pieces follow; the nearest bone when not given. |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'proxy'` | proxy (rigid stand-in) or true (the real surface, skinned). |
| `bind` | `b` | bool | `True` | Bind the pieces to their joint; off leaves them as they are. |
| `parent` | `p` | bool | `True` | Move the pieces under the set. |

```python
addToProxySet("Body_animProxy", "MyHeadProxy", joint="head")
```

### animProxyFromMesh

Make an anim proxy of a skinned mesh in one go: split it along planes (at its joint boundaries when none are given), remesh each piece, bind each to the joint that dominates it and register them in a new proxy set. Returns the set.

Pieces with remesh none, and those of trueJoints, become true pieces: the real surface, skinned like the mesh, for facial animation on the real head while the body stays proxy (setProxyDisplay piece=).

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `planes` | `pl` | Any |  | World planes as splitMesh takes them; the joint boundaries when not given. |
| `suggest` | `sg` | bool | `False` | Add the joint-boundary planes to the given ones. |
| `cap` | `c` | bool | `True` | Close the holes the cuts leave. |
| `remesh` | `rm` | str | `'voxelRemesh'` | How each proxy piece is rebuilt. One of `none`, `quadRemesh`, `voxelRemesh`, `decimate`. |
| `targetFaces` | `tf` | int | `300` | Quad remesh: faces per piece. |
| `resolution` | `res` | int | `32` | Voxel remesh: voxels along a piece's longest side. |
| `ratio` | `r` | float | `0.25` | Decimate: share of triangles kept. |
| `pieceSettings` | `ps` | Any |  | Per piece index: {remesh, targetFaces, resolution, ratio}. |
| `pieceFaces` | `pf` | str |  | Face count per piece, as index:count pairs (0:150 3:80). |
| `exactPieces` | `ep` | str |  | Pieces kept exact (true pieces, skinned like the mesh), by index (1 4). |
| `replace` | `rp` | bool | `True` | Replace the mesh's set at the same LOD level instead of adding another. |
| `trueJoints` | `tj` | list |  | Joints whose pieces also get a true piece, shown by setProxyDisplay piece=. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the new set; <mesh>_animProxy by default. |
| `set` | `s` | str |  | Add the pieces to this set instead of making one. |
| `lodLevel` | `lod` | int | `-1` | The new set's LOD level; -1 for any. |

```python
animProxyFromMesh("Body")
```

```python
animProxyFromMesh("Body", remesh="decimate", ratio=0.1, trueJoints=["head"])
```

```python
animProxyFromMesh("Body", lodLevel=1, resolution=16)
```

### applyAllModifiers

### applyBakeTarget

Apply a target profile or saved preset to a project without grouping or baking: its maps, output settings and group defaults. A group setting (or a high's modifier stack) takes the new default only while it still holds the project's previous default, so settings made on one group by hand survive; overrideGroups=True replaces them too. Groups created later start from the defaults. Returns {target, backend, skipped}.

**Objects:** target

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `optional` | `op` | bool | `False` | Also add the target's optional maps. |
| `overrideGroups` | `og` | bool | `False` | Give every existing group the target's group defaults, including settings made on a group by hand. |

### applyLibraryMaterial

Put a library material on meshes: faces= of one object, the face selection, else whole objects (default the selection). Faces get a new material slot; whole objects keep their one bound slot or get a new one. The slot's texture set takes the material's graph, tiled so one tile spans the material's scaleCm on the surface (from the meshes' uv texel density). With set= and no objects, replaces that set's graph. Returns {set, material, tiles, uvPerCm}.

**Objects:** material [objects...]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `faces` | `f` | list |  | Face ids of the one object given. |
| `slot` |  | str |  | Bind to this existing material slot instead of picking one. |
| `set` |  | str |  | Apply to this texture set (and the meshes using its material). |
| `preset` |  | str |  | A preset of the material's parameters to apply. |
| `values` |  | Any |  | {"Node.param": value} to set after the preset. |
| `scale` |  | bool | `True` | Tile to real-world size; False keeps one tile per uv unit. |
| `tiles` |  | float |  | Tiles per uv unit, overriding the real-world scale. |
| `layer` |  | bool | `False` | Add it as a layer on top of the set's layer stack instead of replacing the set's graph. |

### applyPose

Apply a library pose to the selected character by node name: namespaces are ignored, aliases tried, weight blends from the current pose (rotations slerp), mirror applies it to the other side. Names the rig doesn't have are skipped and reported. Returns {nodes, channels, missing, locked}.

**Objects:** name

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `ch` | str |  | The library group; defaults to the selection's character. |
| `tier` | `ti` | str |  | Only look in this tier. One of `scene`, `workspace`, `user`, `template`. |
| `nodes` | `n` | list |  | Nodes picking the character instead of the selection. |
| `weight` | `w` | float | `1.0` | 0 keeps the current pose, 1 applies the stored one. |
| `mirror` | `m` | bool | `False` | Apply to the opposite side (arm_l values onto arm_r). |
| `mirrorAxis` | `ma` | str | `'x'` | Axis the mirror plane faces. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `channels` | `c` | list |  | Only these channels: translate, rotate, scale or attr names. |
| `aliases` | `al` | Any |  | Extra names per pose node: {poseName: [name, ...]}. |
| `namespace` | `ns` | str |  | Preferred namespace; defaults to the character's. |
| `onlySelected` | `os` | bool | `False` | Only the selected nodes, not the whole character. |

### arap

Add an as-rigid-as-possible handle deformer to a mesh: each handle region gets a locator that drags it, anchors stay, and the surface bends rigidly between. Returns [deformer, handles...].

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` |  | list |  | One entry per handle: its points as ids, components ("Body.vtx[0:9]") or set names. Default: the selected components as one handle. |
| `points` |  | list |  | The points of a single handle, as handles= takes them. |
| `anchors` |  | list |  | Points that stay put, as handles= takes them. |
| `name` |  | str |  | Name for the deformer. |
| `iterations` |  | int |  | Rigidity passes (default 8). |

```python
arap("Arm", handles=["Arm.vtx[120:139]"], anchors=["Arm.vtx[0:19]"])
```

### array

Make a live array of objects, or edit the array named. The objects become its children and it shows them repeated in a row, around a circle or in a grid about its pivot, drawn and exported as instances. Editing an object updates every copy; bakeArray makes them real objects. Returns the array's path.

Settings left out keep the array's current values (a new array's defaults: linear, 5 copies 100 cm apart).

**Objects:** objects, or one array to edit

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `m` | str |  | linear, radial or grid. |
| `count` | `c` | int |  | Copies including the original, 1 to 10000; along x in grid mode. |
| `offset` | `o` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Linear: step between copies in the array's space, cm. |
| `rotate` | `r` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Rotation per copy about the centre, degrees (XYZ). |
| `scale` | `s` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Scale per copy about the centre. |
| `axis` | `ax` | str |  | Radial: the axis copies turn about. A new array defaults to the scene's up axis. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `angle` | `a` | float |  | Radial: degrees spanned (360 closes the ring), or between neighbours with angleMode step. |
| `angleMode` | `am` | str |  | Radial: total or step. |
| `rise` | `ri` | float |  | Radial: climb per copy along the axis, cm. |
| `countY` | `cy` | int |  | Grid: copies along y. |
| `countZ` | `cz` | int |  | Grid: copies along z. |
| `spacing` | `sp` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Grid: distance between copies along each axis, cm. |
| `center` | `ce` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World point the copies turn and scale about (the array's pivot). A new array defaults to the objects' pivot. |
| `edit` | `e` | bool |  | With one array given: edit it (the default), or with False, make an array of it. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of a new array. |

```python
array("Pillar", count=8, offset=[300, 0, 0])
```

```python
array("Spoke", mode="radial", count=12, center=[0, 0, 0])
```

```python
array("Step", mode="radial", count=24, angle=15, angleMode="step", rise=18, center=[0, 0, 0])
```

```python
array("Crate", mode="grid", count=4, countY=1, countZ=3, spacing=[120, 0, 120])
```

### arrayAlongCurve

Repeat meshes along a curve. output=merged adds a live curveArray modifier to each mesh (copies follow curve edits); output=instances places instances of the mesh under a group instead (one shared mesh each, ready to export as instances; not live). Select the piece meshes and the curve. Returns the modifiers, or the groups.

**Objects:** meshes

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fill` |  | str |  | Fill by a number of copies, or by the step between them. One of `count`, `spacing`. |
| `count` |  | int |  | Copies (count fill), start and end pieces included. |
| `spacing` |  | float |  | Step between copies, cm (spacing fill); 0 is the piece's own length so copies butt together. |
| `fitToLength` |  | bool |  | Spacing fill: round the count and even the step so the copies run exactly from end to end. |
| `startOffset` |  | float |  | Room left free at the curve's start, cm. |
| `endOffset` |  | float |  | Room left free at the curve's end, cm. |
| `forwardAxis` |  | str |  | The mesh axis laid along the curve. One of `+x`, `-x`, `+y`, `-y`, `+z`, `-z`. |
| `upMode` |  | str |  | How the mesh turns about the curve: the curve's own frames (no twist, with its tilt), auto normals leaning toward the up vector, or aimed at a second curve. One of `curveFrames`, `autoNormals`, `aimCurve`. |
| `upVector` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Up for auto normals, and where curve frames start. |
| `roll` |  | float |  | Turn about the curve, degrees. |
| `align` |  | bool |  | Turn copies to follow the curve; off, they keep their orientation and only move. |
| `deform` |  | bool |  | Bend each copy along its stretch of the curve (trims, rails, fences) instead of placing it rigidly. |
| `weld` |  | bool |  | Deformed copies: merge the points where neighbours meet. |
| `scaleRamp` |  | str |  | Cross-section scale along the curve: keys "t:scale" with t from 0 to 1, e.g. "0:1 1:0.2". |
| `twist` |  | float |  | Twist from the curve's start to its end, degrees. |
| `twistRamp` |  | str |  | Extra twist along the curve: keys "t:degrees", e.g. "0:0 0.5:90 1:0". |
| `randomRotate` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Random turn per copy about the piece's axes, plus or minus degrees. |
| `randomScale` |  | float |  | Random uniform scale per copy, plus or minus this fraction. |
| `randomOffset` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Random shift per copy along the piece's axes, plus or minus cm. |
| `seed` |  | int |  | Random seed. |
| `curve` | `c` | str |  | The curve to follow; else the selected curve. |
| `aimCurve` |  | str |  | The curve up aims at (upMode aimCurve); else the second selected curve. |
| `startMesh` |  | str |  | A mesh to use for the first copy. |
| `endMesh` |  | str |  | A mesh to use for the last copy. |
| `output` | `o` | str | `'merged'` | merged: one mesh with a live modifier; instances: an instance per copy under a group. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the instance group; made unique. |

```python
lila.ops.arrayAlongCurve("Post", curve="Fence", fill="spacing", spacing=150)
```

```python

```

### bake

Bake a project's maps (or maps=) for its groups (or groups=) and write the textures, plus a {project}_bake.json manifest. Synchronous and cancellable (async=True returns at once and bakes off the main thread). dryRun=True only plans the files. Returns {outputs, stats (samples, hits, misses, backfaces, per group), warnings, manifest, seconds, timings (seconds per stage), backend, backendMode}.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `groups` | `g` | list |  | Bake only these groups. |
| `maps` | `m` | list |  | Bake only these maps (ids from bakeMaps). |
| `dryRun` | `dr` | bool | `False` | Return the files without baking or writing. |
| `backend` | `be` | str | `'cpu'` | Where to bake: cpu, or a GPU backend when one is registered. |
| `async` | `as` | bool | `False` | Return at once and bake off the main thread (bakeStatus shows it running, bakeCancel stops it); the result lands in bakeStatus last. |

Not undoable.

### bakeAll

Bake every bake project in the scene, one after another. changedOnly=True skips projects whose inputs match their last bake. Projects with autoAssign (or assign=True) wire their outputs into materials. Returns [{project, baked, reason, outputs, misses, seconds}].

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changedOnly` | `co` | bool | `False` | Skip projects that are up to date. |
| `assign` | `as` | bool | `False` | Run bakeAssign after each bake. |
| `backend` | `be` | str |  | Where to bake; the GPU when one is registered, else cpu. |

Not undoable.

### bakeArrange

Toggle the Arrange display: a project's groups drawn side by side along X (by their bounds) for inspection, each group's lows, highs and cage moved together. View only: scene meshes never move, the scene file doesn't change and bakes always run where the meshes are. on= sets it instead of toggling; reset=True turns it off. Returns {arranged, offsets: {group: [x, y, z]}}.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `on` |  | bool |  | Arranged (True) or not (False); toggles when left out. |
| `spacing` | `sp` | float |  | Gap between groups, cm; 10% of the largest group by default. |
| `reset` | `rs` | bool | `False` | Turn it off: everything back where the meshes are. |

Not undoable.

### bakeArray

Turn arrays into plain groups holding their sources and a real object per copy, placed where the copies were. Returns the groups' paths.

**Objects:** arrays

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `m` | str | `'instance'` | What each copy's meshes share with the source's: copy shares nothing. instance shares the mesh and its whole modifier stack: every copy looks the same and exports as one mesh. reference shares only the base mesh and keeps a modifier stack of its own (same shape, a different bevel). Component edits on a shared mesh reach every copy. |

```python
bakeArray("Array")
```

```python
bakeArray("Array", mode="copy")
```

### bakeAssign

Wire a bake project's last outputs into the materials of the lows they were baked for: normal (DirectX or OpenGL as baked), ambient occlusion, ORM/MRO packed maps, base colour, roughness, metallic, emissive. Slots with no material get one. Returns {assigned, created, skipped}.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `create` | `cr` | bool | `True` | Create materials for slots that have none. |
| `channels` | `ch` | Any |  | Override which material channel a map goes to: {"height": "roughness"}. |

### bakeCage

A bake group's editable cage. create=True duplicates the low pushed out by the auto cage (frontal x cageOffset x the painted bakeOffset) as a mesh the group then uses; edit its points freely, its topology must stay the low's. fromPaint=True moves an existing cage to the auto cage as painted now. reset=True goes back to the auto cage (delete=True also removes the cage mesh). With no flag, reports the cage and whether it matches the low.

**Objects:** group (or its low; default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `create` | `c` | bool | `False` | Create an editable cage from the auto cage. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the created cage; <low>_cage by default. |
| `fromPaint` | `fp` | bool | `False` | Move the cage's points to the painted auto cage. |
| `reset` | `rs` | bool | `False` | Use the auto cage again. |
| `delete` | `del` | bool | `False` | With reset: delete the cage mesh too. |

### bakeCageCoverage

How many of a bake group's rays miss its highs as it would bake now (one sample per texel): samples, misses, backfaces and missRate.

**Objects:** group (or its low; default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resolution` | `res` | int | `512` | Texels per side. |

### bakeCancel

Stop the running bake (an async one, or a synchronous one from another thread). Returns whether one was running.

Not undoable.

### bakeCorrectiveMorphs

Bake what the stack adds on top of linear skinning into corrective morph targets: each joint is turned about each local axis both ways, the difference between the stack and linear skinning is taken back through the skin, and a pose driver reading the joint drives the target (1 at the pose, 0 at rest). The skin goes linear and the deformers it replaces are turned off. Returns {targets, drivers, disabled, residual}.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle` |  | float | `45.0` | Degrees each joint turns either way about its local axes; each pose gets a corrective. |
| `axes` |  | str | `'xyz'` | Local axes to turn about. |
| `falloff` |  | str | `'smooth'` | How each corrective's weight fades toward rest: linear \| smooth \| smoother |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.0001` | Point offsets smaller than this (cm) are left out; a pose with none gets no corrective. |

### bakeCurveSymmetry

Turn curves' symmetry copies into curves of their own and switch symmetry off, so each side can be edited apart. Returns the new curves.

**Objects:** curves (default: the selected curves)

### bakeEstimateCage

Estimate a bake group's cage in one step: paints bakeOffset on its lows so every texel's ray starts just outside the high and meets it, and sets the group's frontal and rear distances (an editable cage moves to the result). Checks itself by tracing the lows as a bake would, growing the cage where rays still miss. One undo step. Returns the miss rates before and after.

**Objects:** group (or its low; default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resolution` | `res` | int | `512` | Texels per side of the coverage check. |
| `iterations` | `it` | int | `4` | Coverage passes that may grow the cage. |
| `margin` | `mg` | float | `0.004` | Gap kept between cage and high, as a fraction of the lows' bounds diagonal. |
| `apply` | `ap` | bool | `True` | Write the result; False only reports it. |

### bakeForTarget

Bake everything a downstream tool needs in one go: applies the target profile's maps and file naming to the project (creating one if needed), auto-groups by _low/_high names when the project has no groups, bakes, and returns the bake result plus {target, skipped} (maps the target wants that are not implemented yet). Targets: unreal, substancePainter, or any in the user or workspace bake/targets folders (bakeTargets).

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `target` | `t` | str |  | Target profile name. |
| `optional` | `op` | bool | `False` | Also bake the target's optional maps. |
| `autoGroup` | `ag` | bool | `True` | Auto-group by name when the project has no groups. |
| `dryRun` | `dr` | bool | `False` | Apply the target and return the planned files without baking. |
| `backend` | `be` | str |  | Where to bake; defaults to the target's backend, else cpu. |
| `async` | `as` | bool | `False` | Return at once and bake off the main thread, as bake async=True. |
| `overrideGroups` | `og` | bool | `False` | Give every existing group the target's group defaults, including settings made on a group by hand. |

### bakeGroup

Create or edit a bake group: the lows that receive maps and the highs projected onto them. A group only traces its own highs, so groups overlapping in space never affect each other, and several groups can write into one texture. Each high carries a bake-only modifier stack (modifiers= or preset=, e.g. "Smooth x2") evaluated into the bake's snapshot only: nothing is added to the scene. self=True bakes the lows onto themselves through such a stack. Creates the group (and a project) when the name is new. Returns the group.

**Objects:** [group]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `lows` | `lo` | list |  | Replace the lows. |
| `highs` | `hi` | list |  | Replace the highs (mesh names). |
| `addLow` | `al` | list |  | Add lows. |
| `removeLow` | `rl` | list |  | Remove lows. |
| `addHigh` | `ah` | list |  | Add highs. |
| `removeHigh` | `rh` | list |  | Remove highs. |
| `self` | `sf` | bool |  | Add (True) or remove (False) the lows themselves as a high. |
| `modifiers` | `md` | Any |  | Bake-only modifier stack, [{"kind": "subdivision", "params": {"levels": 2}}] or a preset name, for the highs given in this call (else every high). Kinds are modifierKinds(). |
| `preset` | `ps` | str |  | A bake modifier preset instead of modifiers=: Smooth x2, Smooth x1-x4, Auto Bevel + Smooth, none. |
| `cage` | `cg` | str |  | A cage mesh with the low's topology (one low); empty uses the auto cage. |
| `cageOffset` | `co` | float |  | Scales the auto cage's push (frontal distance). |
| `frontal` | `fd` | float |  | How far outside the low rays start, cm; 0 is auto (measured against the highs). |
| `rear` | `rd` | float |  | How far inside the low rays reach, cm; 0 is auto (measured against the highs). |
| `ignoreBackfaces` | `ib` | bool |  | Rays only hit high faces facing them. |
| `aoScope` | `as` | str |  | AO occluders: self, group or all. |
| `skew` | `sk` | float |  | 0 to 1: tilts rays from the smooth normals toward each low face's normal. |
| `addHighFile` | `ahf` | list |  | Add highs streamed from files at bake time (.fbx, .obj, .abc), never loaded into the scene. |
| `removeHighFile` | `rhf` | list |  | Remove file highs. |
| `fileObject` | `fob` | str |  | With addHighFile: only the file's meshes whose name contains this. |
| `fileFrame` | `ffr` | float |  | With addHighFile: the Alembic frame to read. |

### bakeGroupPerMesh

One bake group per mesh: each given (or selected) mesh becomes the low of its own group, so meshes that overlap or share a UV sheet still bake in isolation. Highs come from _high/_hi/_HP names matching the mesh's base name; a mesh without one bakes onto itself (self) through preset= (e.g. Smooth x2). A mesh already a low of a group of the project keeps that group. Returns the groups.

**Objects:** [meshes]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; created when the scene has none. |
| `preset` | `ps` | str |  | Bake modifier preset for self highs (Smooth x2, Auto Bevel + Smooth). |

### bakeLint

Check a bake project before baking: hard edges off UV seams, overlapping UVs (also across groups writing one texture), missing or degenerate UVs, texel density outliers, mirrored islands against tangent signs, lows with no high in range, highs outside the cage, non-planar faces whose triangulation depends on the exporter, and cage topology. bake runs it first and lists its warnings. Returns {issues: [{check, severity, group, mesh, message, data}], warnings, checks, distances: [{group, frontal, rear, frontalAuto, rearAuto, measured}]} (Auto distances are measured against the highs when highs is on).

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `groups` | `g` | list |  | Lint only these groups. |
| `checks` | `c` | list |  | Run only these checks (the names in checks of the result). |
| `highs` | `hi` | bool | `True` | Load the highs for the range and cage checks (False is quick: low checks only). |
| `backend` | `be` | str | `'cpu'` | Backend tracing the range check's rays. |

Not undoable.

### bakeLiveMaps

Live mesh maps: keeps a bake project's maps on the GPU at a preview resolution, for texture graphs and the viewport, and rebakes only the texel tiles an edit to a low or cage touches. enable=True starts (or reconfigures) it, disable=True drops it, update=True rebakes what changed now and waits; with none of them, returns the status.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `enable` | `e` | bool | `False` | Start, or restart with these options. |
| `disable` | `d` | bool | `False` | Stop and drop the images. |
| `update` | `u` | bool | `False` | Snapshot now and rebake what changed, waiting for it; returns the update's stats. |
| `maps` | `m` | list |  | Map ids from the project's list; default every enabled map the GPU bakes. |
| `groups` | `g` | list |  | Bake groups to include; default all of the project's. |
| `resolution` | `r` | int | `0` | Texels per side; 0 uses the bake/liveResolution pref (1024). |
| `supersampling` | `ss` | int | `0` | Samples per texel (1, 4, 16, 64); 0 uses the bake/liveSupersampling pref (1). |
| `padding` | `pd` | int | `-1` | Dilation in texels; -1 scales the project's padding to the resolution. |
| `debounce` | `db` | int | `-1` | Milliseconds of quiet after an edit before rebaking; -1 uses the bake/liveDebounceMs pref. |
| `set` | `st` | str |  | The set: empty for the project's own, cagePreview for the cage view's. |

Not undoable.

### bakeMapInfo

The live mesh map images of a bake project (bakeLiveMaps): per low, map and UDIM tile its version (bumped on every rebake), resolution, format, colour space and decode data. map=, udim= and low= narrow it down.

The maps the baker implements: id, label, default suffix, how texels resolve (average, exact, coverage) and options.

Bake meshes to their current result, deleting the generator and modifiers feeding them. Curves likewise keep what their history makes and lose the history; other objects are skipped.

Merge offsets down into the layer below (or the base animation), sampled every frame across the keys.

### bakePaint

Paint a low's bake cage attributes: offset (bakeOffset, scales the auto cage push per point, 1 unpainted) or skew (bakeSkew, added to the group's skew, tilts rays toward the face normal). op add, subtract, smooth or set, at points=, within radius of center= (world space), or flood=True everywhere (the component selection in component mode). symmetry mirrors across an axis. One undo step. Returns the attribute's min, max and mean.

**Objects:** mesh (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attr` | `at` | str | `'offset'` | offset or skew. |
| `op` | `o` | str | `'set'` | add, subtract, smooth or set. |
| `value` | `v` | float | `1.0` | The amount to add or subtract, or the value to set. |
| `strength` | `st` | float | `1.0` | 0 to 1: how far each dab moves toward its result. |
| `points` | `pt` | list |  | Point ids to paint at full weight. |
| `center` | `ce` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World-space brush centre; points within radius get a smooth falloff. |
| `radius` | `r` | float |  | World-space brush radius, cm. |
| `flood` | `fl` | bool | `False` | Apply to every point (or the selected components). |
| `symmetry` | `sy` | str | `'none'` | Mirror across x, y or z (object space). One of `none`, `x`, `y`, `z`. |

### bakePiecesToJoints

Bake a mesh of moving rigid pieces (a destruction simulation) onto joints.

Makes a new mesh at the first frame's shape, skinned one piece per joint under a root at the origin, and keys the joints on every frame, so the motion can be edited with the animation tools or exported as an FBX skeletal mesh with animation. Pieces are the int piece point attribute, or the connected parts. Returns {mesh, root, joints, residual} (residual: worst point error of the fit, cm).

**Objects:** mesh (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `st` | float |  | First frame. Without start and end the playback range is used. |
| `end` | `e` | float |  | Last frame, inclusive. |
| `step` | `s` | float | `1.0` | Frame step. |
| `playbackRange` | `pr` | bool |  | Sample the scene's playback range (the default without start and end). |
| `fps` |  | float | `0.0` | Frames per second; 0 uses the scene's. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the new mesh (its joints take it as a prefix); default <mesh>_Rigid. |
| `hideSource` | `hs` | bool | `True` | Hide the animated mesh baked from. |

```python
bakePiecesToJoints('Wall', start=1, end=72)
```

### bakePivot

Turn the objects onto their pivots' axes, counter-rotating their points, so the pivot orientation becomes the object's own and scale works along it. Nothing moves in the world. Instances are made unique.

**Objects:** objects

### bakeSkinWeights

Fit linear skin weights (SSDR, Dem Bones) to everything the mesh's stack does: centres of rotation and direct delta mush skinning, delta mush, wrap and other deformers after the skin. The skin goes linear and the deformers it replaces are turned off, so the viewport shows what Unreal will get; keep=true stores the weights for export instead. Returns {rmse, maxError, linearRmse, frames, helpers, disabled}.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle` |  | float | `45.0` | Degrees each joint turns either way about its local axes. |
| `axes` |  | str | `'xyz'` | Local axes to turn about. |
| `sweep` |  | bool | `True` | Poses turning one joint about one axis at a time, each way. |
| `randomPoses` |  | int | `20` | Poses turning every joint at once by a random amount within angle. |
| `seed` |  | int | `1` | Seed of the random poses. |
| `source` |  | str | `'rangeOfMotion'` | rangeOfMotion poses the joints; animation samples the scene's animation. |
| `start` |  | int |  | animation: first frame (the playback start by default). |
| `end` |  | int |  | animation: last frame (the playback end by default). |
| `step` |  | int | `1` | animation: frames between samples. |
| `helpers` |  | int | `0` | animation: extra joints solved with the weights and keyed over the frames (for jiggle and other motion joints can't follow). |
| `maxInfluences` | `mi` | int | `0` | Influences per point; 0 uses the skin's. |
| `iterations` |  | int | `3` | Solver passes. |
| `keep` |  | bool | `False` | Store the weights for export only and leave the scene as it is. |

### batchRename

Rename many objects at once: a new name, find/replace (plain or regex, $1 for groups), strip, case, prefix and suffix, in that order. In name, replace, prefix and suffix '#' runs number the objects (## is 01, 02...), and {name}, {parent} and {type} insert the original name, the parent's name and the node type. Defaults to the selection. Returns [{path, from, to, status}], status one of renamed, unchanged, reference, empty, clash (Lila numbers it).

| `suffix` |  | str |  | Added at the end. |

### batchRun

Run a Python script over many scene files, each opened in its own lilabatch worker, several at once. The script sees ctx: ctx.file, ctx.output, ctx.index, ctx.args (scriptArgs), ctx.results (a dict collected into the summary and CSV), ctx.save = False to leave a file unsaved, ctx.skip(reason). Returns the run's summary (with files once finished): {id, state, total, counts, seconds, dir, csv, files}.

**Objects:** files, folders or globs

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | `s` | str |  | Python source to run in every file. ctx (lila.batch.BatchContext) is in its globals. |
| `scriptFile` | `sf` | str |  | A .py file to run instead; tracebacks point into it. |
| `sceneScript` | `ss` | str |  | Run a script saved in the open scene, by name. |
| `recursive` | `r` | bool |  | Walk folders all the way down. Default: only the folder itself. |
| `depth` | `d` | int |  | How many folder levels to walk below each input folder; -1 for all. |
| `extensions` | `ext` | list |  | File types folders are searched for ("ma", ".lila"). Default: every type Lila opens. |
| `include` | `inc` | list |  | Globs a file must match (name, or path below its folder when it has a slash). |
| `exclude` | `exc` | list |  | Globs that leave a file out. |
| `excludePrefix` | `xp` | str |  | Leave out files whose name starts with this. |
| `excludeSuffix` | `xs` | str |  | Leave out files whose name (without extension) ends with this. |
| `excludeContains` | `xc` | str |  | Leave out files whose name contains this. |
| `fileList` | `fl` | str |  | Add the files of a saved file list (batchRunFileList). |
| `save` | `sv` | str |  | none (default), overwrite (in place; other formats save as .lila beside them) or saveAs. |
| `outputDir` | `o` | str |  | saveAs: the folder to write to. Default: beside each source. |
| `suffix` | `sx` | str |  | saveAs: added to each file name ("_fixed"). |
| `format` | `fmt` | str |  | saveAs: lila or lilaa. Default: the source's, .lila for other formats. |
| `keepTree` | `kt` | bool |  | saveAs: mirror the folders below each input folder under outputDir. Default on. |
| `checkout` | `co` | str |  | auto (default) checks read-only files out through source control; never leaves them. |
| `makeWritable` | `mw` | bool |  | Clear the read-only flag of files source control does not take. |
| `workers` | `w` | int |  | Files processed at once, each in its own lilabatch. Default 0: half the cores, at most 8. |
| `stopOnError` | `soe` | bool |  | Start no more files after one fails. Default: carry on. |
| `timeout` | `to` | float |  | Seconds a file may take before its worker is ended; 0 for no limit. |
| `dryRun` | `dry` | bool |  | Only report the plan: each file, where it saves and whether it can be written. |
| `scriptArgs` | `sa` | Any |  | A dict handed to the script as ctx.args. |
| `csv` |  | str |  | Write the summary table here when the run finishes. |
| `preset` | `p` | str |  | Start from a saved preset (batchRunPreset); flags given here override it. |
| `wait` |  | bool |  | Block until the run finishes. Default: wait in batch mode, return at once with a UI. |

Not undoable.

### batchRunCancel

Cancel a batch run: its workers are ended and the files not started yet are left cancelled.

Not undoable.

### cast

### centerJoint

Move each joint (or any node with centerInMesh/centerMeshes attrs) to the centre of the mesh cross-section across its bone: the meshes are cut by the plane through the joint perpendicular to parent->joint (or joint->first child), and the joint moves to the area centroid of the loop it sits in, or the nearest loop. Meshes come from centerMeshes, else the skinClusters it influences. Returns the nodes moved.

**Objects:** joints

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keepChildren` | `kc` | bool | `False` | Leave the children where they are. |
| `direction` | `d` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World cutting direction instead of the bone's. |
| `meshes` | `m` | list |  | Meshes to centre in instead of the node's own. |

### centerMeshes

Bind nodes to the meshes they centre in (their centerMeshes attr), overriding the skinCluster lookup. With no meshes flag, returns the meshes each node centres in now.

**Objects:** joints

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `meshes` | `m` | list |  | Mesh names; [] clears the binding. |
| `centerInMesh` | `cim` | bool |  | Also turn live centring on or off. |

### centerPivot

Move pivots to the centre of each object's bounding box (mesh points, curve points and handles, and everything parented under it, so a group centres on its children) without moving the object.

**Objects:** objects

### changeStream

Serve scene changes to other processes as JSON lines over TCP: one message per command or undo step, plus resync, scene events and snapshots on request. Returns the server's state.

Without flags it only reports; port or allowRemote alone start or restart it. The general prefs /changeStream/enabled, /port and /localOnly start it with Lila; this command changes the running session only.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enable` | `e` | bool |  | Start (True) or stop (False) the server. |
| `port` | `p` | int |  | Port to listen on; 0 picks a free one. Default: the /changeStream/port pref, 8742. |
| `allowRemote` | `ar` | bool |  | Listen on every network interface rather than 127.0.0.1 only. Clients must then send the token this returns (general.json /changeStream/token). Default False. |
| `requireToken` | `rt` | bool |  | Make clients send the token even on 127.0.0.1, as allowRemote does: for machines other users share. Default False. |

Not undoable.

```python
changeStream(enable=True)
```

```python
changeStream(enable=True, port=0)["port"]
```

```python
changeStream(enable=True, requireToken=True)["token"]
```

```python
changeStream(enable=False)
```

### componentInfo

Positions, normals and adjacency of a mesh's components in bulk. Faces: center, normal, area, points, edges, neighbors (faces across each edge). Edges: points, center, length, faces, border. Vertices: position, normal, edges, neighbors (points), faces. World space unless space='object'. ids= picks some (default: the selected ones of that kind, or all).

**Objects:** [mesh]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'face'` | vertex, edge or face. |
| `ids` |  | list |  | Component ids; [first, last] pairs are ranges. |
| `space` |  | str | `'world'` | world or object. |
| `fields` |  | list |  | Keys to keep per component, e.g. ['id', 'center', 'normal'] (default all). |

Not undoable.

### componentSelection

Selected components: {mesh: {"vertices": [...], "edges": [...], "faces": [...]}}. ordered=True gives a flat list [[mesh, kind, id], ...] in pick order instead (kind is vertex, edge or face).

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ordered` |  | bool | `False` | True: a flat list [[mesh, kind, id], ...] in the order the components were picked. False: grouped per mesh and kind, ids sorted ascending, pick order lost. |

Not undoable.

### conformCurve

Keep curves on a mesh surface: their points are placed on it, lifted by offset, whenever the curve or the mesh changes, so moving points slides them along it (Maya's Make Live for curves). release=True lets them go again, back to where they were last moved. Returns the curves.

**Objects:** curves (default: the selected curves)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mesh` | `m` | str |  | The surface (default: the selected mesh). |
| `offset` | `o` | float |  | Lift off the surface along its normal, cm (default: keep the curve's own, 0 at first). |
| `release` | `r` | bool | `False` | Stop conforming instead. |

connectAttr('src.attr', 'dst.attr'). A whole array input ('loft1.sections') gets a new last element. Returns the destination plug.

### contour

Slice meshes into curves at evenly spaced parallel planes (Rhino's Contour): every spacing cm along axis through origin, or count planes spread through the meshes. One curve node holds every cut, kept live while history is on. Returns [curve, curveContour].

**Objects:** meshes (default: the selected meshes)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | The planes' normal: contours step along it; a section's plane faces it. |
| `origin` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | A point every contour plane is a whole number of spacings from; the section plane passes through it. |
| `spacing` |  | float |  | cm between contour planes (count 0). |
| `count` |  | int |  | Contour planes spread evenly through the meshes, their ends left out; 0 uses spacing. |
| `tolerance` |  | float |  | Simplify each curve within this many cm; 0 keeps every crossing. |
| `smooth` |  | bool |  | Fit smooth Beziers (corners kept) instead of poly lines. |
| `bridge` |  | bool |  | Close cuts through open meshes across their gaps instead of leaving them open. |
| `constructionHistory` | `ch` | bool | `True` | Keep the contour node so the curves follow the meshes and settings. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Curve name; made unique. |

Convert the rotate animation of transforms (default the selection) to `to`, keeping the key times and the pose at every key: euler (three curves) or one rotation curve interpolated by slerp or smooth. Also sets rotationInterpolation, so later keys follow. Returns the number of nodes changed.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `to` |  | str | `'smooth'` | euler \| slerp \| smooth |

### convertSelection

Convert the component selection to another kind and switch to that mode. In object mode the selected meshes convert as a whole: every component of that kind.

**Objects:** to

### convertToInstance

Replace meshes identical to a source with instances of it, dropping their own copies of the data: cleans up imported kits. The source is the last mesh given (the lead); with only the source, every other mesh in the scene is checked. Returns the meshes converted.

**Objects:** meshes... source

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.001` | Points may differ by this much, object space, cm. |
| `force` |  | bool | `False` | Convert the given meshes even when their geometry differs from the source's. |

```python
convertToInstance("Bolt")  # every copy of Bolt in the scene
```

```python
convertToInstance("Bolt2", "Bolt3", "Bolt")
```

Offset body parts non-destructively for polish: a new additive layer (made active) holding one adjustable offset per joint, constant over the take or eased over a range. Pose on it at any frame and the whole take moves together; weight, mute, bake or delete it like any layer. Returns the layer.

| `ease` | `e` | float | `0.0` | Frames of ease at each end of the range. |
| `keepChildren` | `kc` | bool | `False` | Children keep their world rotation (offset the torso, keep the head's direction). |
| `channels` | `ch` | str | `'both'` | rotate, translate or both. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Layer name. Default: Offset_<parts>. |

### curve

Create a curve: poly, Bezier or NURBS. Returns its name.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `type` | `t` | str | `'nurbs'` | Spline kind. One of `poly`, `bezier`, `nurbs`. |
| `degree` | `d` | int | `3` | NURBS degree (1 to 7). |
| `closed` | `c` | bool | `False` | A closed loop (periodic for NURBS). |
| `editPoints` | `ep` | bool | `False` | NURBS: the points are edit points the curve passes through. |
| `knots` | `k` | list |  | NURBS knots: points + degree + 1 values, or points + 1 breakpoints when closed. |
| `weights` | `w` | list |  | NURBS weights, one per point. |
| `handleL` |  | list |  | Bezier incoming handles, one per anchor. |
| `handleR` |  | list |  | Bezier outgoing handles, one per anchor. |
| `handleType` | `ht` | str |  | Bezier handle type for every anchor. One of `auto`, `vector`, `aligned`, `free`. |
| `tilt` |  | list |  | Twist per point, radians. |
| `radius` |  | list |  | Sweep scale per point. |
| `cornerRadius` |  | list |  | Fillet radius per point, cm. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name; made unique. |
| `splines` |  | list |  | Whole splines as curveData returns them, instead of points and the flags above. |

### curveBoolean

2D boolean of closed planar curves into a new curve with live history (C4D's Spline Mask, Rhino's CurveBoolean): union, subtract (the rest from the first), intersect or xor. Each curve's loops fill even-odd, so a letter's counter stays a hole. Pieces are cut exactly from the inputs, with sharp corners where they cross. Returns [curve, curveBoolean].

**Objects:** target tools...

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `operation` |  | str | `'union'` | union joins every input, subtract cuts the others out of the first, intersect keeps what all share, xor what an odd number cover. |
| `normal` |  | tuple[float, float, float] | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | Plane normal; zero fits the plane to the curves. |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.002` | Where the cuts fall: chord error of the clip, cm. The pieces are cut from the input curves. |
| `constructionHistory` | `ch` | bool | `True` | Keep the history node so its settings stay live. |
| `hideInputs` |  | bool | `False` | Hide the input curves (they still drive the result). |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the result curve; made unique. |

### curveCenterLine

Centre lines (the medial axis of the straight skeleton) of the region closed planar curves bound, as poly curves with live history. Returns [curve, curveCenterLine].

**Objects:** curves

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `normal` |  | tuple[float, float, float] | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | Plane normal; zero fits the plane to the curves. |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.01` | Tessellation of curved input, cm. |
| `constructionHistory` | `ch` | bool | `True` | Keep the history node so its settings stay live. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the result curve; made unique. |

A curve's splines: [{type, closed, degree, points, knots, weights, handleL, handleR, typeL, typeR, tilt, radius, cornerRadius}, ...], object space unless worldSpace=True. Also its length and spans.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `worldSpace` | `ws` | bool | `False` | World space. |

Not undoable.

### curveNetwork

Surface a network of crossing curves with quads, live: the curves sort into U and V families (or uCurves/vCurves say), become edge loops, and the surface stays smooth across them. Every U curve must cross every V curve; three-sided patches where one family meets at a point are fine. Returns [mesh, curveNetwork].

**Objects:** curves

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tolerance` | `tol` | float | `0.1` | Curves closer than this meet, cm. |
| `spansU` | `su` | int | `4` | Quads along the U curves between neighbouring V curves. |
| `spansV` | `sv` | int | `4` | Quads along the V curves between neighbouring U curves. |
| `uCurves` |  | list |  | Curves forced into the U family. |
| `vCurves` |  | list |  | Curves forced into the V family. |
| `flip` |  | bool | `False` | Flip the faces. |
| `constructionHistory` | `ch` | bool | `True` | Keep the history node so the result stays live. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Mesh name. |

### curveSculptStroke

One curve sculpting stroke on a curve holding many curves (hair): comb, smooth, length, puff, add, delete, density, cut, pinch or slide. dabs is a list of {center, normal, radius, strength, delta, view} in world space, as the Sculpt Curves tool records them. Roots stay put (on the groom surface) except under slide and add. Returns {changed, added, removed, curves}.

**Objects:** curve

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brush` | `b` | str | `'comb'` | The brush. One of `comb`, `smooth`, `length`, `puff`, `add`, `delete`, `density`, `cut`, `pinch`, `slide`. |
| `dabs` | `d` | list |  | [{center, normal, radius, strength, delta, view}, ...] world space; radius in cm. |
| `falloff` |  | str | `'smooth'` | Falloff: smooth, sphere, root, sharp, linear, constant, bell, or a soft select preset name. |
| `strength` | `s` | float | `0.5` | Brush strength, 0 to 1. |
| `invert` | `i` | bool | `False` | The opposite: shrink, flatten, spread, thin out. |
| `keepLength` |  | bool | `True` | Comb, smooth, puff and pinch keep segment lengths. |
| `frontOnly` |  | bool | `True` | Leave points behind the surface under the brush alone. |
| `addCount` |  | int | `5` | Add and density: curves planted per dab. |
| `addLength` |  | float | `5.0` | Add: length of new curves with no neighbours to copy, cm. |
| `addPoints` |  | int | `8` | Add: points per new curve. |
| `interpolate` |  | bool | `True` | Add: new curves take the shape of their nearest neighbours. |
| `minDistance` |  | float | `0.0` | Add and density: closest roots may be, cm (0: no limit for add, from density for density). |
| `density` |  | float | `1.0` | Density: target curves per square cm, times the density map. |
| `densitySet` |  | str |  | Vertex color set of the surface used as the density map. |
| `seed` |  | int | `0` | Random seed for add, delete and density. |
| `surface` |  | str |  | Mesh the roots grow from; default the curve's groomSurface. |
| `selectedOnly` |  | bool | `True` | With points of the curve selected, only the curves holding them change. |

### curveSymmetry

Mirror curves live across a plane: the copy follows every edit of the curve and history built from it (pipes, sweeps) gets both sides. axis=off turns it off. Returns the curves.

**Objects:** curves (default: the selected curves)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `a` | str | `'x'` | The axis the mirror plane faces. One of `off`, `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `space` | `s` | str |  | Mirror across the world plane through the origin, or the curve's own through its pivot. One of `world`, `object`. |

```python
lila.ops.curveSymmetry("Cable", axis="x")
```

Remove keys (all, or those in time) and copy them for pasteKey. A curve left with no keys is deleted and the channel keeps its value. Returns the number removed.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attribute` | `at` | Any |  | Attribute name or list of names (translate keys all three). |

| `clear` | `cl` | bool | `False` | Don't copy to the clipboard. |

### deformAlongCurve

Bend meshes along a curve with a live curveDeform modifier (Curve Warp, Path Deform). Select the meshes and the curve (a second curve aims the up direction with upMode=aimCurve). The forward axis runs along the curve from its start; editing or moving the curve updates the meshes. Returns the modifiers.

**Objects:** meshes

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forwardAxis` |  | str |  | The mesh axis laid along the curve. One of `+x`, `-x`, `+y`, `-y`, `+z`, `-z`. |
| `upMode` |  | str |  | How the mesh turns about the curve: the curve's own frames (no twist, with its tilt), auto normals leaning toward the up vector, or aimed at a second curve. One of `curveFrames`, `autoNormals`, `aimCurve`. |
| `upVector` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Up for auto normals, and where curve frames start. |
| `roll` |  | float |  | Turn about the curve, degrees. |
| `offset` |  | float |  | Where the mesh starts along the curve, cm. |
| `offsetFraction` |  | float |  | Where the mesh starts along the curve, as a fraction of its length (added to offset). |
| `stretch` |  | bool |  | Stretch the mesh to run from its start to the curve's end; off keeps its length. |
| `loop` |  | bool |  | On a closed curve, wrap past the seam; off treats it as open at its start. |
| `endBehavior` |  | str |  | Past an open curve's end: carry on straight along the end tangent, or pile up at the end. One of `extrapolate`, `clamp`. |
| `envelope` |  | float |  | How much of the deformation applies, 0 to 1. |
| `scaleRamp` |  | str |  | Cross-section scale along the curve: keys "t:scale" with t from 0 to 1, e.g. "0:1 1:0.2". |
| `twist` |  | float |  | Twist from the curve's start to its end, degrees. |
| `twistRamp` |  | str |  | Extra twist along the curve: keys "t:degrees", e.g. "0:0 0.5:90 1:0". |
| `curve` | `c` | str |  | The curve to follow; else the selected curve. |
| `aimCurve` |  | str |  | The curve up aims at (upMode aimCurve); else the second selected curve. |

```python
lila.ops.deformAlongCurve("Rail", curve="Path", forwardAxis="+x", stretch=True)
```

### driveChannel

| `preInfinity` |  | str | `'constant'` | Before the first key. One of `constant`, `linear`, `cycle`, `cycleRelative`, `oscillate`. |

Driven channels: all, or those touching the given nodes or plugs (as driver or driven). [{node, driver, driven, keys, preInfinity, postInfinity, curveName, input, output}]; keys are [driver value, driven value, interpolation].

**Objects:** nodes or plugs?

Not undoable.

### duplicate

Duplicate objects with their children, keeping each mesh's generator and modifier stack live. Returns the new top-level names.

count makes a run of copies, copy i placed by the translate/rotate/scale step applied i times about the pivot: a row, a ring or a spiral in one call. mode instance shares the mesh (edits to one change all); reference shares the base mesh but gives each copy its own modifier stack.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name for a single duplicate. |
| `count` | `c` | int | `1` | Copies of each object, 1 to 10000. |
| `translate` | `t` | tuple[float, float, float] | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | Move from one copy to the next, cm. |
| `rotate` | `r` | tuple[float, float, float] | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | Rotation from one copy to the next about the pivot, degrees (XYZ). |
| `scale` | `s` | tuple[float, float, float] | `[1.0, 1.0, 1.0]` | Scale from one copy to the next about the pivot. |
| `pivot` |  | str | `'object'` | What the step rotates and scales about. One of `object`, `world`, `point`. |
| `pivotPoint` |  | tuple[float, float, float] | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | World point rotated and scaled about when pivot is point, cm. |
| `space` |  | str | `'world'` | Axes the step is measured along: the world's or each object's own. |
| `mode` | `m` | str | `'copy'` | What a duplicated mesh shares with its source: copy shares nothing. instance shares the mesh and its whole modifier stack: every copy looks the same and exports as one mesh. reference shares only the base mesh and keeps a modifier stack of its own (same shape, a different bevel). Component edits on a shared mesh reach every copy. |
| `group` | `g` | bool | `False` | Put the copies under a new group. |

```python
duplicate("Pillar", count=7, translate=[200, 0, 0])
```

```python
duplicate("Spoke", count=11, rotate=[0, 30, 0], pivot="world", mode="instance")
```

```python
duplicate("Step", count=20, translate=[0, 18, 0], rotate=[0, 15, 0], pivot="point", pivotPoint=[0, 0, 0])
```

### duplicateWithTransform

Duplicate the last duplicated object again, placed by how its copy now sits relative to its source. Duplicate an object, move, rotate or scale the copy, then repeat this to continue the run. Returns the new names.

The step is measured from the current world matrices of the last source and copy, so it follows any later edit to the copy and survives selection changes. It is forgotten when either object is deleted.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `c` | int | `1` | Copies to add, 1 to 10000. |

```python
duplicate("Fence")
move("Fence1", by=[120, 0, 0])
duplicateWithTransform(count=8)
```

Edit a bound skeleton without deforming its mesh. on=True puts the skeleton (of the given meshes or joints, else every skinned one) in bind pose and holds its animation; move, orient and re-pivot joints freely, then on=False rebinds the skins to the new joints and re-expresses the animation for them. preserve="worldPose" keeps every joint's world placement at each key (a moved joint keeps its move); "channels" keeps the raw key values. ### exportFbx

Export the evaluated meshes and transforms to a binary FBX 7.4 file. Objects default to the selection (or the whole scene with selectionOnly=False). Names go out intact, so UCX_/UBX_/USP_/UCP_ collision and SOCKET_ empties work in Unreal. kind=skeletal writes joints, skins (bind pose mesh, clusters, BindPose), morph targets (in-betweens as their own targets) with their weight curves, driven channel curveNames as named curves on the root joint, and the animation baked over the range; kind=animation writes only the skeleton and its curves. kind=sequence writes cameras and transforms with their animation and no meshes, for Unreal Sequencer's Import FBX: cameras go out as FBX cameras (focal length aperture mode, film back, clipping, focal length and clipping curves) and arrive as CineCameras. Cameras are written as FBX cameras in every kind. start/end are frames. Returns the path.

### exportGltf

Export the evaluated meshes, skeletons and cameras to glTF 2.0: binary .glb, or JSON .gltf with a .bin and image files next to it (or everything embedded as data URIs). Objects default to the selection (or the whole scene with selectionOnly=False). Axes become glTF's Y up with the model facing +Z, lengths metres (see units).

Meshes go out triangulated as the viewport splits them, one primitive per material slot, with normals, MikkTSpace tangents, every UV set (flipped to glTF's V-down) and every color set. Skinned meshes go out in their bind pose with JOINTS_n/WEIGHTS_n sets (four influences each, up to maxInfluences) and inverse bind matrices; morph targets with position and normal deltas (sparse where few points move), names in extras.targetNames and their weights. Each take becomes one animation (takes=, or the current animation over start/end): sampled every frame and thinned where interpolation reproduces the samples, translate and scale curves written as their own keys with bakeAnimation=False. Cameras keep their field of view, aspect and clipping.

Materials go out metallic-roughness: base color and opacity, ORM maps shared as glTF's metallic-roughness and occlusion textures (other layouts and separate maps repacked), DirectX normal maps green-flipped to OpenGL, emissive with KHR_materials_emissive_strength above 1, specular through KHR_materials_specular, alpha mode, cutoff and double sided; unlit materials as KHR_materials_unlit with their base color. Each map's wrap and filter go in its texture's sampler (black borders clamp). Textures that aren't PNG or JPEG are converted to PNG.

draco=True compresses every primitive with KHR_draco_mesh_compression (then required to read the file), quantized per the dracoBits flags: positions, normals, UVs, colors and generic attributes (tangents, skin weights; joint indices stay exact). Morph targets stay uncompressed accessors, as the extension requires, with the points encoded in order so they still line up. Returns the path.

**Objects:** path objects...

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` |  | bool |  | Write binary .glb; by default from the extension. |
| `embedImages` |  | bool |  | Put images inside the file (default for .glb); off writes them next to it. |
| `embedBuffers` |  | bool | `False` | .gltf only: put the geometry inside the file as a data URI instead of a .bin. |
| `textures` |  | bool | `True` | Write texture maps; off writes material factors only. |
| `copyTextures` |  | bool | `True` | Unembedded images: copy textures next to the file; off references them where they are. |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'auto'` | auto \| static \| skeletal \| animation \| sequence. auto writes everything (meshes, skins, morph targets, cameras, animation), static only meshes and transforms (no animation, allows worldSpace), animation the skeleton and its animation, sequence cameras and transforms. auto picks sequence when only cameras are given. |
| `maxInfluences` | `mi` | int | `8` | Skin influences per vertex, heaviest kept and renormalised (4 for one JOINTS_0 set). |
| `animation` | `anim` | bool | `True` | Write animation. |
| `bakeAnimation` | `bake` | bool | `True` | Sample every frame; False writes plain translate and scale curves as their own keys. |
| `deformOnly` | `do` | bool | `True` | Skip non-deform joints (IK helpers and rig-only joints). |
| `start` | `st` | float |  | First frame; the playback start by default. |
| `end` | `et` | float |  | Last frame; the playback end by default. |
| `take` |  | str |  | Animation name; the active take's, else Take 001. |
| `takes` |  | Any |  | Scene takes to write, one glTF animation each: 'all' or a list of names. |
| `tangents` |  | bool | `True` | Write MikkTSpace tangents from uv0. |
| `normals` |  | bool | `True` | Write normals (and morph target normal deltas). |
| `morphNormals` |  | bool | `True` | Write morph target normal deltas. |
| `draco` |  | bool | `False` | Compress mesh primitives with KHR_draco_mesh_compression. |
| `dracoPositionBits` |  | int | `14` | Draco quantization bits for positions. |
| `dracoNormalBits` |  | int | `10` | Draco quantization bits for normals. |
| `dracoUvBits` |  | int | `12` | Draco quantization bits for UVs. |
| `dracoColorBits` |  | int | `8` | Draco quantization bits for vertex colors. |
| `dracoGenericBits` |  | int | `12` | Draco quantization bits for tangents and skin weights. |
| `dracoLevel` |  | int | `7` | Draco compression level, 0 fastest to 10 smallest. |
| `worldSpace` | `ws` | bool | `False` | Bake world transforms into the meshes and flatten the hierarchy (static exports). |
| `atOrigin` |  | bool | `False` | Drop the exported roots' own transforms, keeping their children relative. |
| `children` |  | bool | `True` | Include the descendants of the given objects. |
| `units` | `u` | str | `'m'` | File units: m (glTF's), cm, mm, in or ft. Lengths are scaled to them. |
| `selectionOnly` | `sl` | bool | `True` | Without objects: the selection, or every root when False. |

Not undoable.

### exportMLDeformer

Training data for an Unreal ML Deformer: a range-of-motion take (or the given take), the skinned mesh as a skeletal FBX (its non-linear skinning fitted to linear weights), the take as an animation FBX and the full deformer stack over it as an Alembic geometry cache. When connected to Unreal it imports all three and creates the ML Deformer asset on them; training stays a click in the ML Deformer editor. Returns {files, take, frames, assets}.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### exportVertexAnimation

Bake animated meshes (geometry nodes, deformers, skins, anything that changes over time) into Vertex Animation Textures: a rest mesh FBX with an extra UV channel addressing each vertex's texels, a position texture (offsets or positions per vertex per frame, Unreal space), a normal texture and a JSON sidecar describing the layout. Changing topology is baked as a padded triangle soup; rigid pieces as a position and a rotation texture with one column per piece. Returns {files, meta, materialParams} (the material inputs: HDR, BoundsMin, BoundsMax, FrameCount, RowsPerFrame, TextureHeight, FrameRate, PositionTexture, NormalTexture; rigid adds RotationTexture, PieceCount, PivotChannelXY, PivotChannelZ).

**Objects:** meshes

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `st` | float |  | First frame. Without start and end the playback range is used. |
| `end` | `e` | float |  | Last frame, inclusive. |
| `step` | `s` | float | `1.0` | Frame step. |
| `playbackRange` | `pr` | bool |  | Sample the scene's playback range (the default without start and end). |
| `fps` |  | float | `0.0` | Frames per second; 0 uses the scene's. |
| `scale` | `sc` | float | `1.0` | Global scale applied to every length (0.1 shrinks to a tenth). |
| `profile` | `ax` | str | `'ue5'` | Axis profile: ue5, ue6 or generic (the scene's axes). |
| `applyModifiers` | `am` | bool | `True` | Export the evaluated mesh; off exports the base mesh without its modifiers. |
| `worldSpace` | `ws` | bool | `True` | Bake each object's world transform; off writes object space. |
| `recenter` | `rc` | str | `'none'` | none, first (move the first frame's centre to the origin, the same offset for every frame) or each (centre every frame). |
| `normals` | `n` | bool | `True` | Bake a normal texture (<name>_nrm.png). |
| `uvs` | `uv` | bool | `True` | Write UV sets. |
| `colors` | `vc` | bool | `True` | Write the first color set as vertex colors. |
| `dryRun` | `dr` | bool | `False` | Return the files without writing anything. |
| `folder` | `fo` | str | `'vat'` | Output folder; relative paths are under the workspace. |
| `name` | `nm` | str | `'{name}'` | File base name; {name} is the first mesh. |
| `format` | `f` | str | `'exr'` | Position texture: exr (half float offsets, HDR=1), png16 or png8 (normalised by BoundsMin/BoundsMax, HDR=0). |
| `mode` | `md` | str | `'auto'` | constant (every frame keeps the rest frame's vertices), soup (unwelded triangles, for changing topology), rigid (loose pieces that only move and rotate: one position and one rotation texel per piece per frame, pieces from the int point attribute 'piece' or connected components) or auto (soup when the topology changes, rigid when every mesh has 'piece' and every piece fits a rigid motion within 0.01 units, constant otherwise). |
| `positions` | `po` | str | `'offset'` | offset (from the rest mesh, for World Position Offset) or absolute. |
| `normalBits` | `nb` | int | `8` | Normal texture depth, 8 or 16. |
| `restFrame` | `rf` | float |  | Frame whose shape is the rest mesh (default the first sampled frame). |
| `maxWidth` | `mw` | int |  | Widest texture before a frame wraps to more rows (default the vat maxWidth pref, 4096). |
| `exrBits` | `eb` | int |  | EXR depth: 16 (half float) or 32 (float). Default 32 for rigid, 16 otherwise. |

Not undoable.

### exportWebViewer

Write a folder to upload to a website for showing a model interactively: model.glb (exported as by exportGltf, materials and textures embedded), index.html (Google's <model-viewer> loaded from a CDN, with orbit controls, turntable and a caption) and environment.hdr (the viewport's HDRI).

The page must be served over http(s); browsers block model.glb when index.html is opened from disk. Returns the folder.

**Objects:** folder

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selection` | `sl` | bool |  | Export the selection; False exports the whole scene. Default: the selection when there is one. |
| `title` | `t` | str |  | Caption title, also the page title. |
| `author` | `au` | str |  | Caption line under the title. |
| `autoRotate` | `ar` | bool | `True` | Start with the turntable spinning. |
| `background` | `bg` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Page background, sRGB 0 to 1; the viewport background by default. |
| `exposure` | `ex` | float |  | Exposure in stops; the viewport exposure by default. |
| `tonemapper` | `tm` | str | `'neutral'` | Tone mapping: neutral, aces or agx. |
| `environment` | `env` | bool | `True` | Light with the viewport's HDRI (copied as environment.hdr); off uses model-viewer's neutral lighting. |

Not undoable.

```python
lila.ops.exportWebViewer("C:/Portfolio/Ship", title="Ship", author="Jared Taylor")
```

Sweep a profile along path curves into a quad mesh with live history: a circle or rectangle, or the profile curve given second (or with profile=). Returns [mesh, curveSweep].

**Objects:** path [profile]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `radius` |  | float |  | Circle radius, cm. |
| `sides` |  | int |  | Circle sides. |
| `width` |  | float |  | Rectangle width, cm. |
| `height` |  | float |  | Rectangle height, cm. |
| `alignProfile` |  | bool |  | Turn a profile curve to face along the path and centre it on the path start; off sweeps it from where it lies. |
| `twist` |  | float |  | Twist from start to end, degrees. |
| `scaleStart` |  | float |  | Profile scale at the start. |
| `scaleEnd` |  | float |  | Profile scale at the end. |
| `startCap` |  | str |  | Close the start: one face, a quad grid, or a rounded dome. One of `none`, `ngon`, `grid`, `round`. |
| `endCap` |  | str |  | Close the end: one face, a quad grid, or a rounded dome. One of `none`, `ngon`, `grid`, `round`. |
| `roundSegments` |  | int |  | Rings in a rounded cap. |
| `frameMode` |  | str |  | How the profile turns along the path: rotation minimising (no twist), toward the up vector, or Frenet. One of `rmf`, `fixedUp`, `surfaceNormal`, `frenet`. |
| `upVector` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Up for fixedUp frames, and the start orientation of others. |
| `miter` |  | bool |  | At corners, set the profile in the bisector plane so walls keep their width. |
| `texelDensity` |  | float |  | V per cm along the path; 0 fits each part to 0..1. |
| `splitEvery` |  | float |  | Split the body into parts (own UV island and part id) every this many cm; 0 is none. |
| `flip` |  | bool |  | Flip the faces. |
| `tessellation` |  | str |  | How curves become points: fixed segments per span, adaptive to the error and angle, or game (straight spans one segment, curved ones by angle, corners exact). |
| `segments` |  | int |  | Segments per curved span (fixed). |
| `chordError` |  | float |  | Largest gap from the true curve, cm (adaptive). |
| `maxAngle` |  | float |  | Largest turn between segments, degrees (adaptive and game). |
| `profileCurve` | `pc` | str |  | Profile curve (instead of the second positional). |
| `constructionHistory` | `ch` | bool | `True` | Keep the history node so its settings stay live. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Mesh name; made unique. |

### ezCurve

Create a curve between two points that adapts to the meshes it runs over: it follows their surface (follow) and is kept out of them (clearance), lifted off by lift. bend bows it out and sag droops it, as fractions of the distance between the points; twist turns the bow about that line. Returns the curve.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `s` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | [x, y, z] start, world space, cm. |
| `end` | `e` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | [x, y, z] end, world space, cm. |
| `startNormal` | `sn` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Surface normal at the start, which way the bow faces. |
| `endNormal` | `en` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Surface normal at the end. |
| `mesh` | `m` | list |  | Meshes to adapt to (names). |
| `bend` | `b` | float | `0.0` | Bow out from the straight line, fraction of its length. |
| `twist` | `tw` | float | `0.0` | Turns the bow about the line, degrees. |
| `sag` | `sg` | float | `0.0` | Droop down under gravity, fraction of the length. |
| `lift` | `l` | float | `0.0` | Height off the surface, cm. |
| `follow` | `f` | bool | `True` | Follow the surface between the points. |
| `clearance` | `c` | bool | `True` | Push the curve out of the meshes wherever it dips into them. |
| `points` | `p` | int | `12` | Points the curve passes through. |
| `symmetry` | `sym` | str | `'off'` | Mirror the curve live across the world plane facing this axis. One of `off`, `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name; made unique. |

```python
lila.ops.ezCurve(start=[0, 0, 0], end=[100, 0, 0], bend=0.25, twist=30)
```
